description:
**Original Webtoon:**    
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=856246), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=14885449)    

A son murders his mother who opposed his marriage. The public is thrown into turmoil when the bride-to-be is named as the mastermind behind the incident.
Meanwhile, webtoon artist Nam Mi-hong, upon discovering that the bride-to-be is her college classmate,
begins drawing her past in a comic book driven by personal revenge and a desire for success...
